operation.name: OSGB36 to WGS 84 (6)
operation.why: OSTN15 grid (EPSG:7710, 1 m) not available offline (no grid file, no network), so used the best applicable one: EPSG:1314, 2 m, area GB onshore and nearshore contains the valid points.

assumptions: Read as OSGB36 (EPSG:4277) decimal degrees, latitude first, west negative.
notes: P02 (47.36N, 2.96E, central France) and P07 (64.45N, 124.27E, eastern Siberia) lie outside the area of use of OSGB36 and of EPSG:1314; swapping lat/lon does not bring either into Great Britain, so they look like rows that don't belong. Not transformed (null values); would only transform them on the owner's say-so, marked as outside.
